paragraphs.text: Ramona Ruvalcaba Ponce participated in Meeting H15-11-01 on 2011-11-02. Liga del Cedro Lunar was linked to Meeting H15-11-01 on 2011-11-02. Meeting H15-11-01 occurred at Highway 15 on 2011-11-02. A trucking dispatcher with regular runs on the Pacific highway reported that Ruvalcaba, the deputy of Liga del Cedro Lunar known as La Monja, met the network's lawyer at a roadside restaurant on Highway 15 north of Guadalajara to settle how the lanes on the highway would be assigned to the network's own trucks and to crews paying for passage. The dispatcher was present at the restaurant and recognized both women from prior dealings.

Ramona Ruvalcaba Ponce used DEMO-TEL-00109 on 2011-11-02. Meeting H15-11-01 transited Highway 15 Pacific route on 2011-11-02. Liga del Cedro Lunar controlled Highway 15 Pacific route from 2010-11-18 until 2013-06-11. The dispatcher stated that Ruvalcaba made several calls during the meeting from the telephone identified above and that the lawyer, Minerva Barragán Toledo, took notes on which crews would be allowed which days. The dispatcher characterized the highway as the network's route at this time, with its control extending from Guadalajara to the Sonora border.

Everardo Montemayor Ruvalcaba led Liga del Cedro Lunar from 2010-11-18 until 2018-04-26. Ramona Ruvalcaba Ponce was a member of Liga del Cedro Lunar from 2010-11-18 until 2027-01-01. The dispatcher described Montemayor as the head of the network and Ruvalcaba as his cousin and deputy from the founding. The dispatcher added that the lane assignments favored the network's own trucks on the days when inspection on the highway was known to be light. The reporting office assesses the dispatcher as having direct access to the meeting and a record of accurate reporting on highway traffic.
